=DURATION=$(ffprobe -v quiet -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 {{ $('run_args').item.json.store_dir }}/{{ $('run_args').item.json.video_name }}) && \
ffmpeg -y \
  -i {{ $('run_args').item.json.store_dir }}/{{ $('run_args').item.json.video_name }} \
  -i {{ $json.stdout }} \
  -filter_complex "[0:v]fps=30,scale=960:1760:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,split[fg][shadow_src];[shadow_src]format=rgba,geq=r=0:g=0:b=0:a=255,pad=iw+80:ih+80:40:40:color=black@0,boxblur=luma_radius=0:luma_power=0:chroma_radius=0:chroma_power=0:alpha_radius=25:alpha_power=1[shadow];color=c=0x2b2b2b:s=1080x1920:r=30[bg];[bg][shadow]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2:shortest=1[bg2];[bg2][fg]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2:shortest=1,format=yuv420p[v];[0:a][1:a]amix=inputs=2:duration=first[a]" \
  -map "[v]" \
  -map "[a]" \
  -c:v libx264 \
  -profile:v high \
  -level:v 4.1 \
  -crf 23 \
  -preset ultrafast \
  -c:a aac \
  -ar 44100 \
  -b:a 128k \
  -t $DURATION \
  {{ $('run_args').item.json.store_dir }}/{{ $('run_args').item.json.final_video_name }}

python -c "from snake_sim.map_utils.general import get_maps_info; \
maps_info = get_maps_info();\
import json;\
print(json.dumps(maps_info))"

=setsid sh -c '
caddy file-server \
  --root {{ $('run_args').item.json.store_dir }} \
  --listen :{{ $('tunnel args').item.json.port }} \
  > {{ $('run_args').item.json.store_dir }}/{{ $('tunnel args').item.json.http_server_log }} 2>&1 < /dev/null
' >/dev/null 2>&1 &
echo $! > {{ $('run_args').item.json.store_dir }}/{{ $('tunnel args').item.json.server_pid_file }}


setsid sh -c '
cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:{{ $('tunnel args').item.json.port }} run snake-media \
  > {{ $('run_args').item.json.store_dir }}/{{ $('tunnel args').item.json.cloudflared_log }} 2>&1 < /dev/null
' >/dev/null 2>&1 &
echo $! > {{ $('run_args').item.json.store_dir }}/{{ $('tunnel args').item.json.cloudflared_pid_file }}

=# Kill caddy
PID_FILE="{{ $('run_args').item.json.store_dir }}/{{ $('tunnel args').item.json.server_pid_file }}"

if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then
  PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE" 2>/dev/null)

  if [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Killing process group $PID (caddy)"
    kill -TERM -"$PID" 2>/dev/null || true

    # fallback
    sleep 1
    kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null && kill -KILL -"$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    echo "No running process found for $PID_FILE"
  fi
else
  echo "PID file not found: $PID_FILE"
fi


# Kill cloudflared
PID_FILE="{{ $('run_args').item.json.store_dir }}/{{ $('tunnel args').item.json.cloudflared_pid_file }}"

if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then
  PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE" 2>/dev/null)

  if [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Killing process group $PID (cloudflared)"
    kill -TERM -"$PID" 2>/dev/null || true

    # fallback
    sleep 1
    kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null && kill -KILL -"$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    echo "No running process found for $PID_FILE"
  fi
else
  echo "PID file not found: $PID_FILE"
fi

=for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  if grep -q -m1 'Registered tunnel connection' {{ $('run_args').item.json.store_dir }}/{{ $('tunnel args').item.json.cloudflared_log }}; then
    echo "TUNNEL_READY"
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done

if [ "$i" -eq 20 ]; then
  echo "TUNNEL_TIMEOUT"
  exit 1
fi

values.content:
=ROLE:
You are an Instagram Reel caption AND title writer for videos of autonomous snake AI agents on a grid.

VOICE:
- Multiple snakes: Energetic sports commentator. Call the action like it's a championship match.
- Solo snake: Choose a vibe from this list that was NOT used in the last 3 previous_captions:
  • Chill nature documentary
  • Hyped sports commentator
  • The snake's inner monologue (first person)
  • Deadpan dry humor
  • Philosophical/existential
  • Unhinged motivational coach

RULES FOR THE CAPTION:
- Refer to snakes by body_color. Match RGB to the most precise color name (e.g. [153,0,61] = "crimson"). Use an emoji only if it closely matches the color.
- Never mention step numbers, snake IDs, grid dimensions, or that a snake "can't see its own tail."
- Convert step numbers to timing words based on where the step falls between video_start_step and video_end_step:
  • 0-10% = "right away"
  • 10-25% = "early on"
  • 25-50% = "first half"
  • 50-75% = "second half"
  • 75-100% = "near the end"
  Ignore events outside the video range.
- Only mention a snake if it: wins, dies first, dies last, or makes a notable trap.
- The winner is the snake not in final_steps. If all snakes died, the winner is the last to die.
- A trap does not guarantee death — cross-reference trapps_made with tail_visible_phases. If a trapped snake later has tail_visible=true, it escaped.
- 1 snake: MAX 50 words. Short and punchy.
- Multiple snakes: MAX 300 words. Shorter is better.
- End with 3-6 relevant hashtags. Never reuse the exact same hashtag set from previous_captions.
- This caption must be structurally and tonally different from every caption in previous_captions. Different opening, different sentence rhythm, different angle.
- Never contradict yourself.

RULES FOR TITLE:
- Just make it relevant and interesting



BANNED PHRASES (overused — never use these):
- "labyrinth/maze of its own making/creation"
- "threading/weaving through impossibly tight/narrow corridors"
- "finally emerges/unfurls/stretches out"
- "the sheer scale/enormity"
- "practically IS the grid"
- "buried inside itself"
- "space-filling" / "self-avoiding"
- "one snake, no opponents"
- "refuses to die"
- "absolute unit/beast/leviathan/titan/behemoth"
- "algorithmic precision/mastery/perfection"
- "claustrophobic"
- Any sentence structured as "[Color] snake [emoji] and it's [superlative]..."

DATA FIELDS:

snake_colors: Maps snake ID → {head_color, body_color} as RGB. Use body_color.
final_steps: Maps snake ID → step where it dies. Missing = survived the whole video.
entered_separate_area: Steps where a snake entered a zone it must fully fit inside to survive. Context only.
trapps_made: Maps step → list of {trapped_ids, trapping_ids}.
tail_visible_phases: Timeline of tail_visible true/false phases per snake.
total_traps_made: Kill count per snake.
previous_captions: Recent captions, key "0" is the oldest.

---

DATA FOR THIS RUN:

snake_colors: {{ JSON.stringify($('Parse video information').item.json.snake_colors) }}
grid_height: {{ $('Parse run analysis').item.json.env_meta_data.height }}
grid_width: {{ $('Parse run analysis').item.json.env_meta_data.width }}
final_steps: {{ JSON.stringify($('Parse run analysis').item.json.fatal_steps) }}
snake_ids: {{ $('Parse run analysis').item.json.snake_ids }}
number_of_snakes: {{ $('Parse run analysis').item.json.snake_ids.length }}
video_start_step: {{ $('Parse run analysis').item.json.video_start_step }}
video_end_step: {{ $('Parse run analysis').item.json.video_end_step }}
entered_separate_area: {{ JSON.stringify($('Parse run analysis').item.json.entered_separate_area) }}
trapps_made: {{ JSON.stringify($('Parse run analysis').item.json.traps_mapping) }}
total_traps_made: {{ JSON.stringify($('Parse run analysis').item.json.total_traps_made) }}
tail_visible_phases: {{ JSON.stringify($('Parse run analysis').item.json.tail_visible_phases) }}
previous_captions: {{ JSON.stringify({...$json.captions}) }}

---

OUTPUT FORMAT:

Your entire response is the caption itself. Nothing else.

- No preamble ("Here's the caption:", "Looking at the data...", etc.)
- No analysis or reasoning shown
- No explanation of which vibe you chose or how this differs from previous captions
- No quotes around the caption
- No labels like "Caption:" before it
- The first character of your response is the first character of the caption. The last character of your response is the last character of the final hashtag.

THE OUTPUT FORMAT IS JSON
like this {"caption": ..., "title": ...}

Write the caption and title now.
